definitions.gloss: old model; old type; outdated version
definitions.explanation: A previous version or model of a product, machine, or system that has been replaced by a newer one. Commonly used for electronics, vehicles, and equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旧型|きゅうがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧だ。
{旧型|きゅうがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Old model smartphones have poor battery life.

examples.japanese: {旧型|きゅうがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Plans to replace old equipment with new models are underway.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (old, former) + {型|がた} (model, type). Often used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {旧型|きゅうがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～. The opposite is ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧ (new model).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧型|きゅうがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (an old model car)
- {旧型|きゅうがた}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}える→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧ (to upgrade from the old model to the new model)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧: new model — the antonym
- ⟦{型落|かたお}ち→型落ち：16064_kataochi⟧: discontinued model — specifically a model no longer in production, often sold at a discount
